ArticleLayout-module-scss-module__W3addq__wrap"><div class="ArticleLayout-module-scss-module__W3addq__content"><div class="text-rich-text text-rich-text--article w-richtext"><p>Starting today, Claude can turn your data into a dashboard that stays current, and your ideas into an animated explainer for your next presentation. Claude Dashboards connects to a data platform like BigQuery, Databricks or Snowflake, or a CRM tool like Salesforce, and is in beta on paid plans. Claude Motion is in beta on Team and Enterprise. Claude Docs, Slides, and Design are out of beta and available on every plan, including Free.</p><figure><div class="Video-module-scss-module__miVj5a__video Video-module-scss-module__miVj5a__youtubeEmbed Media-module-scss-module__7ZZCyW__video" data-youtube-id="en0GuyhieQk"><iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/en0GuyhieQk?enablejsapi=1&amp;rel=0&amp;playsinline=1&amp;modestbranding=1&amp;autoplay=1&amp;mute=1" title="Claude builds a dashboard from bike-share ride data, then animates it with Claude Motion." allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-presentation allow-popups" allowFullScreen="" class="Video-module-scss-module__miVj5a__player"></iframe></div></figure><p>Asking questions about company data usually means filing a ticket or writing SQL. And ideas that would land better in motion usually end up as another static slide. So people wait, or skip it. Claude could already help with parts of this. Now you can ask for the dashboard or the animation itself, and see how Claude made it. Each chart shows the query behind it, and each animation is built as code you can edit. Claude makes the first version, and you decide what gets shared.</p><h2 id="claude-dashboards-ask-quick-questions-of-your-company-s-data">Claude Dashboards: ask quick questions of your company’s data</h2><p>Connect your company’s data platform, such as Amazon Redshift, BigQuery, ClickHouse, Databricks, or Snowflake, and ask a question in plain language. Claude pulls answers from your data, builds the dashboard, and keeps it current as the data changes. It works with your other connectors too. For example, you can ask for a dashboard of your Salesforce opportunities. Dashboards work well for quick, exploratory questions, like how this week’s signups compare with last month’s. Click any number to see the query behind it, or ask Claude to explain it. Each chart shows when its data was last refreshed.</p><figure style="--media-natural-width:1920px"><img referrerPolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" src="https://assets.claude.com/7688d4d3b888c17cf4b3553f537f291882a92656.png" width="1920" height="1080" alt="Claude builds a bike share dashboard from a year of ride data, with trip totals and charts of rides per day and by hour." loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="Media-module-scss-module__7ZZCyW__image"/></figure><p>Dashboards work alongside your BI and analytics tools. When a question needs deeper analysis, send the dashboard from Claude straight to Amplitude, Grafana, Hex, Mixpanel, Omni, Perplexity, PostHog, or Sigma and pick up the analysis from there, with Looker, monday.com, and Tableau coming soon.</p><h2 id="claude-motion-explain-your-ideas-with-animation">Claude Motion: explain your ideas with animation</h2><p>Ask Claude to turn a quarterly report into a 30-second explainer for an all-hands, add motion to a chart in a board deck, or make a product walkthrough for customer onboarding. Claude builds an animation from your prompt, and it plays like a short video. You can adjust it in the editor or ask Claude to change it, then download it as an MP4 file.</p><figure style="--media-natural-width:1920px"><img referrerPolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" src="https://assets.claude.com/46f88e8de631c732fa245ad453262e6ef35c0e73.png" width="1920" height="1080" alt="Typing “/motion” in the Claude message box brings up the Motion option." loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="Media-module-scss-module__7ZZCyW__image"/></figure><p>Claude Motion is built for explaining your own work. Claude writes code that animates your text, charts, shapes, and images, so you can change any word, number, or timing. It doesn’t use a video generation model, so there’s no generated footage and no AI-generated people. When you want to take it further, open it in Adobe, Descript, HeyGen, Higgsfield, invideo, Luma AI, or Runway, with Canva and Captions coming soon.</p><h2 id="docs-slides-and-design-are-ready-for-everyday-work">Docs, Slides, and Design are ready for everyday work</h2><p><a href="https://claude.com/blog/cowork-is-now-claude" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Since we introduced Docs, Slides, and Design in every Claude conversation<span class="sr-only" lang="en" data-export-skip=""> (opens in new tab)</span></a>, people have made more than 45 million docs, decks, and designs in Claude. Most of what we’ve shipped since came from your feedback, and it makes them easier to use every day. So we’re taking the beta label off.</p><ul><li><strong>Ready for enterprise.</strong> Artifacts now support CMEK, and admins choose which artifact templates their organization uses.</li><li><strong>Edit with your team. </strong>Your team and Claude can work on the same doc, deck, design, or dashboard.</li><li><strong>Share beyond your team.</strong> Share slides, designs, dashboards, and animations with people outside your organization, or with anyone who has the link, if your admin allows it.</li><li><strong>Exports that keep your formatting.</strong> PowerPoint and PDF downloads look like what you made in the editor, and decks go straight to Google Slides as editable files.</li><li><strong>Edit on your phone.</strong> Change a doc, deck, or design in the Claude mobile app.</li></ul><h2 id="claude-design-has-moved-into-claude">Claude Design has moved into Claude</h2><p>Claude Design started at its own URL, claude.ai/design. Since September 16, Design also works inside every Claude conversation, where it can use your context, files, and connectors. Running two versions slows down fixes for both, so we’re folding the standalone site into Claude. It stays at <a href="http://claude.ai/design" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">claude.ai/design<span class="sr-only" lang="en" data-export-skip=""> (opens in new tab)</span></a> until December 14, so you have time to move over.</p><ul><li><strong>Migrate your design systems today.</strong> On the Artifacts page in Claude, click &quot;Migrate team design systems.&quot; One migration brings over every design system in your organization, and the originals stay unchanged in the standalone version until it closes.</li><li><strong>Your projects need nothing from you yet.</strong> They keep working in the standalone version until it closes.</li><li><strong>Save your chats and comments.</strong> Chats with Claude and comments on your projects stay in the standalone version and won&#x27;t be available after it closes. Public links to standalone projects stop working then too.</li></ul><p>Read the <a href="https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17440474" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">migration guide<span class="sr-only" lang="en" data-export-skip=""> (opens in new tab)</span></a> for more information.</p><h2 id="getting-started">Getting started</h2><p>Open Claude and ask for what you need, like “Build a dashboard of this quarter’s revenue by region,” “Animate how our pricing plans compare for the sales kickoff,” or “Turn these notes into a deck for Monday.” Start with the dashboard you’d wait for, or the report that needs more than a slide.</p><p><strong>For Enterprise admins:</strong> Dashboards and Motion are off by default, and you can turn them on in Organization settings &gt; Artifacts. Docs, Slides, and Design turn on by default October 15, or you can turn them on today.</p></div></div></div></div><section class="RelatedPosts-module-scss-module__fDzNNG__root"
